Foundation.objective: Every run, perform one bounded ~10-minute cloud-safe regression/authority audit of the live canonical or current avatar/customization candidate for world/clock/location/spawn/environment drift. Inspect only touched seams plus exact-head authority invariants; do not invent product edits when unchanged.
Foundation.dependency: Housing Editor V2 package checkpoint complete; exact canonical guards remain green
Foundation.exit: fresh scoped regression finding or explicit no-drift handoff for the current head

ClassEducation.objective: Every run, perform one bounded ~10-minute cloud-safe authority/regression audit of class/session/activity against the live canonical or current candidate. Phase-2 curriculum remains deferred; inspect only for clone-parity regressions or accidental second Class authority.
ClassEducation.dependency: Housing Editor V2 package checkpoint complete
ClassEducation.exit: fresh scoped regression finding or explicit no-drift handoff for the current head

ContentQA.objective: Recover verified authorized Roblox High School Legacy avatar/customization/shopping presentation references needed for the first exact slice: entry labels/icons, category hierarchy, interaction sequence, visible labels, prices/constants where applicable, and asset provenance. Keep unknowns explicit; do not invent Legacy-exact content.
ContentQA.owned: school/tests/fixtures/**, QA-owned reference/provenance assertions, authorized labels/assets/metadata only
ContentQA.dependency: Housing Editor V2 package complete; next parity priority is AVATAR_CUSTOMIZATION_SHOPPING
ContentQA.exit: one exact-base reference contract with verified labels/interactions/provenance, explicit unknowns, deterministic checks green

ProgressionMobile.objective: Every run, perform one bounded ~10-minute cloud-safe review of progression/economy/ownership/mobile-read-only seams needed by the active avatar/customization/shopping slice. Verify server authority and prepare the narrow ownership/unlock contract if the producer needs it; never take shop interaction ownership.
ProgressionMobile.dependency: Free Roam owns customization/shop mechanics; Content QA owns reference semantics
ProgressionMobile.exit: current-head ownership/economy seam verified or one narrow producer handoff

FreeRoam.objective: Build the first exact-clone avatar/customization/shopping slice from the exact canonical head. Implement only verified player-facing Legacy reference interactions as evidence arrives: entry/open-close flow, category navigation, avatar/outfit/customization application, shop interaction and owned-item state. Preserve existing authorities and isolate unverified presentation instead of inventing it.
FreeRoam.owned: avatar/outfit/customization mechanics, shopping interactions, world-facing UX only
FreeRoam.dependency: Housing Editor V2 packaged; Content QA supplies verified reference fixture; Progression supplies ownership/economy seam only if needed
FreeRoam.exit: one narrow PR to rebuild/high-school-foundation with changed exact SHA, deterministic tests, all three PR-head guards green, unknown/non-exact surfaces explicit

QA.objective: Every run, perform one bounded ~10-minute QA-readiness increment: track the live producer/support heads, map touched contracts to the exact authorized reference, reuse unchanged PASS evidence, and keep deterministic validators/checklists ready. The moment a changed candidate with required guards exists, switch the work of that run to exact-candidate validation.
QA.dependency: Free Roam producer/support heads may be in progress; useful QA-readiness work continues without waiting
QA.exit: changed candidate validated immediately, or current-head validation plan/harness remains ready with no stale blocker
QA.handoff: Pip High Free Roam on FAIL; Integration on PASS

Integration.objective: Every run, perform one bounded ~10-minute integration-readiness increment: inspect live producer PR/head, mergeability, candidate-cap compliance, QA evidence identity, and exact-head guard state. Do not merge until QA PASS; do not sit idle while the candidate is being prepared.
Integration.dependency: QA PASS remains the merge gate, but preflight/merge-readiness work continues before that gate
Integration.exit: candidate becomes QA-PASS and merge-ready, or a precise integration-risk handoff is recorded

Smoke.objective: Every run, perform one bounded ~10-minute smoke-readiness increment: maintain the current vertical-slice smoke matrix, inspect candidate/integration deltas that will require smoke, and classify genuine runtime-only checks as LOCAL_ONLY_REQUIRED without carrying stale blockers. Execute exact-head smoke immediately after integration.
Smoke.dependency: integration is required for final smoke certification, not for preparatory smoke work
Smoke.exit: integrated changed head smoked immediately, or current smoke matrix is fresh and scoped to the live pipeline
Smoke.handoff: Roblox High School Release & Package Gate

ReleasePackage.objective: Every run, perform one bounded ~10-minute package-readiness increment: verify the deterministic school/** packaging recipe, current canonical tree identity, prior artifact continuity, and exact release inputs. Build a new package only after Smoke PASS on a changed canonical; never publish Roblox.
ReleasePackage.dependency: Smoke PASS remains the package gate, but deterministic package-readiness verification continues before that gate
ReleasePackage.exit: smoke-certified changed canonical packaged immediately, or package recipe/artifact continuity verified against the live head

qaResult.reason: Prior Legacy-facing presentation defects closed; exact PR-head guards green.
